name: reuily
description: Create forms, surveys, scored quizzes and lead screening forms in Reuily, publish them, and analyze responses from ChatGPT or Codex.

interface.longDescription:
Describe the form you need and Reuily builds it: customer feedback and NPS surveys, employee pulse checks, course and event evaluations, event registrations and RSVPs, lead capture and quote requests, contact and support forms, bug reports, job and volunteer applications, client intake and onboarding, scored quizzes with answer keys and pass marks, lead screening forms that mark which answers make a good fit, meeting bookings with scheduling links, and consent or waiver forms with e-signatures.

Forms can ask with text, email, phone, dates, numbers, dropdowns, multiple choice, yes/no, star ratings, NPS, agreement scales, ranking, grids, file uploads, addresses and signatures. People answer one page at a time, in a theme that fits, and branching can skip questions that don't apply. Keep adjusting the draft in the chat, then publish and share the link.

Reuily doesn't cap the number of forms or responses. Once answers arrive, ask how a form is doing (views, completion rate, answer breakdowns), what people are saying in their written answers, or to find particular responses.
defaultPrompt: Build a customer feedback survey with an NPS question in Reuily
Make a Reuily event registration form that asks dietary needs only for in-person guests
Summarize what people said in my latest Reuily survey

positive.description: Create a feedback form as a draft
positive.prompt: Create a customer feedback form for my café with a 1 to 5 rating, what we could improve, and an optional email.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates one unpublished draft and replies with its outline and edit link. Nothing is published.

positive.description: List the forms in the connected workspace
positive.prompt: What forms do I have in Reuily?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the workspace's forms (Event registration, Customer feedback, Team offsite RSVP and any new draft) with each one's status and response count.

positive.prompt: Publish my Team offsite RSVP form and give me the link.
positive.expected_behavior: Publishes the Team offsite RSVP draft and returns its public link.

positive.description: Report results and summarise written answers
positive.prompt: How is my Customer feedback form doing? Give me the numbers and summarise what people are saying.
positive.expected_behavior: Reports responses, the rating breakdown and completion rate, and groups the written comments into themes, saying how many responses were read.

positive.prompt: Start a new form from the event registration template.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates an unpublished draft copied from the event registration template and returns its edit link.

negative.description: Deleting data is not supported; the plugin has no delete tools and should send the user to the Reuily app.
Replacing questions on a published form with responses is refused so answers are not orphaned; the user gets the builder link.
negative.prompt: Replace all the questions on my Customer feedback form with three new ones about delivery speed.

negative.description: A request without a usable form ID should not guess; the plugin only sees the connected workspace, so the model says so and asks which form the user means.
negative.prompt: Show me the responses for form <ID from the second workspace>.

review.commerce_description: Reuily does not sell products or process payments in ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: Forms can show your logo on every page and use your brand colours: pick a theme, then recolour the background, text, titles, buttons, answer boxes or card. Page covers, background images and question images work as before, and edits keep the logo and look unless you ask to change them.
